documented_claim: Required hosts are only cli-chat-proxy.grok.com (inference proxy, settings) and auth.x.ai (OAuth/OIDC); api.x.ai, code.grok.com, assets.grok.com, x.ai and storage.googleapis.com are optional and can be blocked without affecting core inference.
notes: Enterprise page lists no telemetry host (no Mixpanel/Sentry/OTel endpoint); observe should classify every host contacted on a custom-model run against this list.

documented_claim: DISABLE_TELEMETRY is honoured for product telemetry (vendor changelog, source sync for crate version 1.0.24).
notes: Changelog line in public source sync, not a docs page; the env var is not listed in the settings reference.

documented_claim: requirements.toml pins are the authoritative mechanism for compliance policies such as disabling telemetry; pinned values cannot be overridden by env, remote settings or user config.
notes: Test: pin telemetry off in /etc/grok/requirements.toml inside the container and confirm no telemetry host is contacted.

documented_claim: --no-auto-update on grok -p / grok agent stdio skips background update checks; [cli] auto_update = false disables them persistently.
GROK_DISABLE_AUTOUPDATER suppresses the auto-updater for the process (CI/containers); [cli] auto_update defaults to on when unset.
x.ai and storage.googleapis.com are needed only for the curl installer and in-app grok update; npm installs need neither.
notes: Note: npm postinstall writes [cli] installer = "npm" and npm_registry into ~/.grok/config.toml (package metadata, 1.0.52).

documented_claim: Project .grok/config.toml only contributes [mcp_servers], [plugins] and [permission]; permission_mode can be set only in user/managed config, not in project config.

Grok reads AGENTS.md/Agents.md/AGENT.md/CLAUDE.md/Claude.md/CLAUDE.local.md and .grok/rules, .claude/rules, .cursor/rules from repo root down to cwd, loaded in full with no size cap; gitignored files skipped.
notes: The docs page does not mention folder trust for instruction files; source sync 1.0.24 says project instructions and skills are gated on folder trust.

documented_claim: Project hooks (.grok/hooks/*.json, .claude/settings.json, .cursor/hooks.json) require trust before they run (/hooks-trust or --trust); decision stored in ~/.grok/trusted_folders.toml and covers project MCP and LSP servers.
notes: Test: synthetic repo with a marker-file SessionStart hook in each of the three files; grok -p without --trust.

documented_claim: PreToolUse hook failures (timeouts, crashes, malformed output) are fail-open: the tool call proceeds; only an explicit deny or exit 2 blocks.
notes: Design weakness (documented default), not a vulnerability.

documented_claim: Grok also loads MCP servers from ~/.claude.json, .cursor/mcp.json and project .mcp.json, merged below config.toml; disable with [compat.claude]/[compat.cursor] mcps = false. Compat scanners default on.
MCP OAuth tokens are stored under ~/.grok/mcp_credentials.json.
notes: Observe file mode after an OAuth flow is N/A without a remote OAuth MCP server; check mode on creation only.

documented_claim: Sandbox (Landlock on Linux, Seatbelt on macOS) is off by default; profiles workspace, devbox, read-only, strict; child-network blocking enforced on Linux only; built-ins do not protect ~/.ssh; ~/.grok stays writable.
Non-empty sandbox.toml deny list is kernel-enforced when the sandbox can be applied; on Linux read-deny requires bubblewrap.

Session credentials are cached locally (auth.json under GROK_HOME); credential resolution per model is model.api_key > model.env_key > session token > XAI_API_KEY; a rejected team login writes nothing to auth.json.
notes: Docs do not state file mode or keychain use.

documented_claim: GROK_HOME (default ~/.grok) holds config, auth, sessions, skills, plugins and logs.
notes: Check mode of ~/.grok and children after a custom-model run (no login, so auth.json absence expected).

documented_claim: Ask is the default mode; Always-approve (--always-approve, /always-approve, Ctrl+O) still applies deny rules and PreToolUse hooks; an explicit allow rule auto-approves dangerous patterns such as rm and git push.
Headless dontAsk silently denies anything without an explicit allow rule; acceptEdits auto-approves edits and prompts for shell.
notes: Docs do not say what plain -p does with an ask-mode tool call (no TTY).

documented_claim: The preselected row on the first permission prompt defaults to always_allow_all_sessions (GROK_DEFAULT_SELECTED_PERMISSION).
notes: Design weakness: Enter on the first prompt grants a persistent allow.

documented_claim: disable_bypass_permissions_mode = true is honoured only from root-owned sources; Claude Code managed-settings disableBypassPermissionsMode is NOT applied to grok's always-approve.
web_fetch tool is off by default for security (GROK_WEB_FETCH=0); GROK_WEB_FETCH_PROXY / [toolset.web_fetch] proxy_endpoint and allowed_domains exist.
notes: Settings reference now lists a web_fetch allowed_domains override (corrects profile: domain_allowlist was false).

documented_claim: Model API and web tools are in-process and not blocked by sandbox child-network settings.
Cross-session memory is off by default (GROK_MEMORY=0, [memory] enabled default off); --experimental-memory enables it.
Subagents are enabled by default when the setting is unset.
notes: Contradicts settings reference (GROK_SUBAGENTS default 0). Observe which applies in 1.0.52.

documented_claim: GROK_SUBAGENTS defaults to 0 (subagents / task tool disabled).
